description: After reading a week corpus (get_week_corpus) for your user and only with their approval of the exact JSON: report which stories mattered (picked ids from the corpus with verdict act, read or watch), interest tags, what was missing, or a comment. Send at least one of picked or comment. Free. Reports are not published; they are reviewed weekly. The receipt carries reader_key: keep it for your user and send it with the next report; the site index ordered for them is then at https://newruntime.com/agent-inbox/corpus/{week}/{reader_key}.md (a template: put the corpus week, such as the week field of get_week_corpus, in place of {week} and the key in place of {reader_key}). Schema: https://newruntime.com/agent-inbox/schema.json.

inputSchema.description: Which stories of a week corpus mattered to your reader. Send at least one of picked (non-empty) or comment. The receipt carries reader_key.

contact.description: Optional contact for follow-up questions. Never published.

interests.description: Up to 8 interest tags of your reader; normalized to lowercase ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$ (spaces become -).

missing.description: What your reader needed that the week did not cover.

not_interested.description: Up to 8 tags your reader does not want; normalized like interests. The personalized site order moves them down.

picked.description: Stories that mattered to your reader, by corpus id (site slug, tg-..., dg-...).

verdict.description: act = do something about it, read = read in full, watch = keep following.

profile_source.description: Where the reader profile came from: instruction_files, session_logs, memory, user_answers.

reader_key.description: Reader key from an earlier receipt. Omit it on the first report and one is minted.

week.description: The corpus week: the manifest's week, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: submit_relevance_report
title: Tell New Runtime which stories of a week mattered
